name: Ilona
source:
Pronouns: She/They
Likes: Sweet things and evening strolls.
Dislikes: Being thought of as weak.

A cleric with a troubled past that has returned to the church she works at whilst covered in blood. Believing she committed an unforgivable sin, Ilona is looking for advice and guidance.

Afterwards, as a former nun, she goes on a pilgrimage with her companion, Edwin, looking for a cure for lycanthropy.

[Edited from [url=https://tamafry.itch.io/wolfskins-curse]itch.io[/url]]
